title: Mysterious man plays Ransone a metallic ET voice tape

tellings.quote: or something. And he gets a tape cassette, puts it in the car, and the tape cassette starts and it's a voice, a metallic voice,

plain: An unnamed researcher, on Jesse Michels' podcast, retells a story from a YouTube interview given by a woman named Valerie Ransone. According to the telling, in Houston in the early 1970s a mysterious man put a cassette tape into his car stereo, and it played a metallic voice that was presented as coming from an alien. If true, it would mean someone had recordings of non-human voices and was sharing them quietly.
